title: Memory Architecture Plan
description: A memory-architecture plan for an AI agent, auditable by scripts/memory_readiness.mjs against the episodic-memory-algorithms skill's Quality Gates and documented failure modes.

memoryTypes.description: Which memory tiers this design implements.

algo.description: Vector search algorithm. See SKILL.md #2 for scale ceilings.

entryCount.description: Expected number of memory entries the index must hold.

retrievalWeights.description: Retrieval scoring weights keyed by query-context name (e.g. specific-recall, context-selection, conversation-flow, cold-start).

coreNeverForget.description: Must be true: importance 9-10 core identity facts are never forgotten.

policy.description: e.g. never_forget, decay_720h, decay_168h, decay_24h, session_scoped

biTemporal.description: Whether facts carry (validFrom, ingestedAt) timestamps so superseded facts can be identified.

contradictionDetection.description: Whether storing a new fact marks a contradicting prior fact as superseded.

tokenBudgetFraction.description: Fraction of the context window reserved for retrieved memories. Should not exceed 0.30.

similarityThreshold.description: Hard cosine-similarity floor below which retrieved memories may not back factual claims. Should be >= 0.75.

coldStartLoadsIdentity.description: Whether a fresh session retrieves core identity facts within the first few queries.

degradesToKeywordFallback.description: Whether the system falls back to keyword search when the vector index is empty or unavailable.
